newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Petrofield says property deal near.
newsitem.headline: Petrofield says property deal near.

text.p: Philippine oil explorer Petrofields Exploration and Development Co Inc said on Monday it was reviewing the final draft of a memorandum of understanding for the development of a property owned by Benguet Corp.
The company told the Philippine Stock Exchange the memorandum was set to be signed in the second week of January, after which due diligence will begin.
"If the results of the due diligence examination by Petrofields is favourable, Petrofields and Benguet Corp will sign a project development agreement," the company said.
Benguet is a mining firm operating in the northern Philippines.
